title: 03.03 - Meaning of This survey has not yet been published or has already been unpublished
intent: Explain why participants may see a message saying a survey is not published or has been unpublished.
short_answer: This message usually means that the invitation was sent, but the survey has not yet been published, or that it has already been unpublished by the survey organisers.
procedure: Wait and try again if the survey may not yet have been opened.
If the survey should already be available, contact the survey owner for further information.
important_conditions: The availability of a survey is controlled by the survey organisers.
EUSurvey support may not be able to change the publication status of a survey owned by another organiser.
